title: Ultimate Coconut-Crusted French Pistachios Canele
description: Rich, cheese-pull meal-prep dish inspired by Alsatian cuisine, featuring ground pistachios, coconut cream, and plant-based friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a food processor, grind 1 cup of pistachios to a fine crumb.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the ground pistachios, 1/4 cup of granulated sugar, and 1/4 cup of unsweetened shredded coconut.
In a separate bowl, whip the coconut cream until it becomes stiff and holds its shape.
Using a rubber spatula, gently fold the whipped coconut cream into the pistachio mixture until well combined.
